name: Zoster 5% Cream 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZOSTER 5% CREAM

ZOSTER 5% CREAM contains Acyclovir, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivirals. It is used for the management of cold sores associated with the Herpes simplex virus in immunodeficiency adults and adolescents over 12 years of age. It can also be used to speed up the healing of sores and shorten the duration of pain. A cold sore is an infection caused by the herpes simplex virus most often around the mouth. Symptoms include tiny, fluid-filled lesions called cold sores, sore lips, ulcers, blisters or rashes on the skin.

Before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM inform your doctor if you have low immunity, cold sores in mouth or frequent episodes of cold sores greater than 4 times a year. ZOSTER 5% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary. ZOSTER 5% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk.

The most common side effects after applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM are rash, itchy skin, weal, mild drying or flaking of the skin and dry lips. Contact your doctor if your side effects gets worse or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Manage cold sores associated with herpes simplex virus infections
Speeds up the healing process and shortens the duration of pain
Manage recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores) in immunodeficiency adults and adolescents 12 years of age and above
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOSTER 5% CREAM

It is used to:

Manage cold sores associated with herpes simplex virus infections
Speeds up the healing process and shortens the duration of pain
Manage recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores) in immunodeficiency adults and adolescents 12 years of age and above
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOSTER 5% CREAM Works

ZOSTER 5% CREAM works by against or stopping the growth of viruses (herpes virus). It has a higher affinity for viral DNA cells than human DNA cells and incorporates into the viral DNA and causes DNA chain termination and inactivation, leading to the death of cells.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOSTER 5% CREAM

Apply ZOSTER 5% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before applying the medicine. Apply a thin layer of medicine to the affected area. Do not rub the cold sore because this may cause the cold sore to spread to other areas or make your cold sore worse. Use this medicine for up to 5 days.
sideEffects: Redness, itching, mild drying or flaking of the skin, skin rashes, hives and weals
Allergic reaction symptoms such as rash, itchy skin, weal, swelling of the lips, face and/or eyelids
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ZOSTER 5% CREAM
Common
Burning or stinging feeling
Redness, itching, mild drying or flaking of the skin, skin rashes, hives and weals
Dry or cracked lips
Peeling

Stop applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction symptoms such as rash, itchy skin, weal, swelling of the lips, face and/or eyelids

warnings.details: Inform your doctor if you are pregnant before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM. Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.
ZOSTER 5% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM.
Do not apply ZOSTER 5% CREAM if you are allergic to Acyclovir, Valacyclovir, or any of the other ingredients of the medicine.
ZOSTER 5% CREAM should be used with caution in children and adolescents under 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM.
ZOSTER 5% CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM.

Others

ZOSTER 5% CREAM is not recommended for use if you have:

Mouth ulcers
Herpes infections near the eyes, or in the genital area

Before applying ZOSTER 5% CREAM, inform your doctor:

If you have low immunity
If you have frequent episodes of cold sores

HERPERAX OINTMENT works by killing or stopping the growth of viruses (herpes virus). It has a higher affinity for viral DNA cells than human DNA cells and incorporates into the viral DNA and causes DNA chain termination and inactivation, leading to the death of cells.
usageDetails:
How to use HERPERAX OINTMENT

Apply HERPERAX OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before applying the medicine. Apply a thin layer of medicine to the affected area. Do not rub the cold sore because this may cause the cold sore to spread to other areas or make your cold sore worse. Use this medicine for up to 5 days.
sideEffects: Redness, itching, mild drying or flaking of the skin, skin rashes, hives and weals
Allergic reaction symptoms such as rash, itchy skin, weal, swelling of the lips, face and/or eyelids
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of HERPERAX OINTMENT
Common
Burning or stinging feeling
Redness, itching, mild drying or flaking of the skin, skin rashes, hives and weals
Dry or cracked lips
Peeling
Rare

Stop applying HERPERAX OINTMENT and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction symptoms such as rash, itchy skin, weal, swelling of the lips, face and/or eyelids

warnings.details: Inform your doctor if you are pregnant before applying HERPERAX OINTMENT. Consult your doctor before applying.
HERPERAX OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying HERPERAX OINTMENT.
Do not apply HERPERAX OINTMENT if you are allergic to Acyclovir, Valacyclovir, or any of the other ingredients of the medicine.

Others

HERPERAX OINTMENT is not recommended for use if you have:

Mouth ulcers
Herpes infections near the eyes, or in the genital area

Before applying HERPERAX OINTMENT, inform your doctor:

If you have low immunity
Frequent episodes of cold sores

Use in pediatrics:

HERPERAX OINTMENT should be used with caution in children under 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying HERPERAX OINTMENT.

Use in geriatrics:

HERPERAX OINTMENT should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before applying HERPERAX OINTMENT.

name: OCUVIR SKIN Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About OCUVIR SKIN CREAM

OCUVIR SKIN CREAM contains Acyclovir, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivirals. It is used for the management of cold sores associated with the Herpes simplex virus in immunodeficiency adults and adolescents over 12 years of age. It can also be used to speed up the healing of sores and shorten the duration of pain. A cold sore is an infection caused by the herpes simplex virus most often around the mouth. Symptoms include tiny, fluid-filled lesions called cold sores, sore lips, ulcers, blisters or rashes on the skin.

Before applying OCUVIR SKIN CREAM inform your doctor if you have low immunity, cold sores in mouth or frequent episodes of cold sores greater than 4 times a year. OCUVIR SKIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary. OCUVIR SKIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk.

The most common side effects after applying OCUVIR SKIN CREAM are rash, itchy skin, weal, mild drying or flaking of the skin and dry lips. Contact your doctor if your side effects gets worse or persists for a longer duration.
